description: This file defines the BugService class for managing bugs within a FastAPI backend. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting bugs, and gathering bug statistics. It interacts with a Supabase database and a notification service, handling bug-related operations and notifications.

classes.name: BugService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing bug entities, including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and statistics gathering in the backend.

methods.name: BugResponse create_bug(self, bug_data: BugCreate, current_user: UserResponse)
methods.description: Creates a new bug record in the database and sends notification if assigned.

methods.name: List[BugResponse] get_bugs(self, project_id: Optional[str] = None, assigned_to: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of bugs with optional filters for project and assignment.

methods.name: Optional[BugResponse] get_bug_by_id(self, bug_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a specific bug by its ID.

methods.name: BugResponse update_bug(self, bug_id: str, bug_data: BugUpdate, current_user: UserResponse)
methods.description: Updates an existing bug's details and sends notifications for status or assignment changes.

methods.name: bool delete_bug(self, bug_id: str, current_user: UserResponse)
methods.description: Deletes a bug by its ID.

methods.name: dict get_bug_statistics(self)
methods.description: Returns aggregated statistics about bugs, such as total, open, critical, and resolved counts.
